speaker.name: Reliability Ruth
speaker.role: Develops the end-user applications and services that integrate ML models. Handles model deployment, configuration, and continuous monitoring of real-world performance. Employs feedback loops to facilitate iterative improvements and system reliability.

output.objection: I need the nightly pipeline to run on its own so store managers never see stale numbers again. The current proposal leaves too many manual steps in the critical path.
output.correction: I am not asking for a full rewrite of the model, just for the data flow to be automated end to end. This is about reliability, not about changing the forecast logic itself.
